title: R$^2$Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
abstract: arXiv:2610.22740v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In recent years, agentic orchestration has been widely applied to solve complex human tasks. However, existing orchestration learning still faces key challenges, including hand-designed curricula, advantage collapse when a task's rollouts all reach the same outcome, and unreliable evaluation signals that judge each skill by one noisy score. To address these challenges, we propose R$^2$Orch, a new paradigm of Recursive Self-Play Orchestration: an inner loop of self-play that improves the orchestrator on self-chosen tasks, and an outer loop that improves how the inner loop improves. To support this paradigm, we introduce Recursive Learnability, a training objective that rewards a Proposer for choosing tasks whose rollouts keep reaching different outcomes as skills are withdrawn. translated_title: R²Orch：通过技能内化循环中的自我博弈实现智能体编排的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 近年来，智能体编排已被广泛应用于解决复杂的人类任务。然而，现有的编排学习仍然面临一些关键挑战，包括手工设计的课程、当任务的所有 rollout 都达到相同结果时出现的优势坍塌，以及用单一含噪评分来判断每个技能的不可靠评估信号。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 R²Orch，一种新的递归自我博弈编排范式：内循环通过自我博弈在自选任务上改进编排器，外循环则改进内循环的改进方式本身。为支持这一范式，我们引入了递归可学习性，这是一种训练目标，用于奖励提议者选择那些在技能被撤回时 rollout 仍能持续产生不同结果的任务。基于这一目标，我们进一步提出了技能撤回机制，其中外循环在自我博弈内的受控评估表明（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 R²Orch 递归自我博弈编排新范式，通过内循环自我博弈改进编排器、外循环改进内循环本身，并借助递归可学习性目标与技能撤回机制，解决编排学习中手工课程设计、优势坍塌和评估信号不可靠三大难题。
en_tdlr: R²Orch proposes a recursive self-play orchestration paradigm where an inner self-play loop improves the orchestrator and an outer loop improves the inner loop itself, using Recursive Learnability and Skill Withdrawal to tackle hand-designed curricula, advantage collapse, and unreliable evaluation signals.
